thread:
maria: Quick preflight — finalizing release notes and the internal announce for tomorrow's deploy. Need a one-line blurb, rollback criteria, and who owns model/version pinning.
leo: I can own the pin and deploybot config.
amira: I'll draft the blurb. What's the change window?
maria: Change window 14:00–16:00 PST. Canary at ~14:15, prod at ~15:00.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued: `release/2026-03-22` -> staging @14:00 PST, canary 14:15, prod 15:00. CI status: green. :rocket:
sre-oncall: I'm on standby 14:00–16:00 (pager rotation handed over).
jordan: Propose rollback triggers: >1% error rate sustained for 30s OR p50 latency > 1.2s for 5m. Also manual rollback if we see model regressions in eval set.
product-comm: For internal announce copy I'd use: "Performance and stability improvements to inference routing; no user action required." Amira, can you make it tighter?
amira: Draft: "Infra & routing optimizations — improves latency/cost. No user-facing changes. Pinned to model v1.4.2 in prod; fallback to v1.3.x." Thoughts?
leo: Works. For deploybot I will set `pin_version: v1.4.2` and `fallback: v1.3.x` in ops repo. Will push a change and open PR.
maria: Add a line saying canary will be 5% traffic for 10m then ramp if stable. Also mention who to ping on rollback.
product-comm: I'll own scheduling the internal announce at 15:30 and include exec CC.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp plan: 0% -> 5% over 10m -> 25% over 30m -> 100% if no alerts.
amira: Adding quick rollback commands to the runbook: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=1234``` and `deploy-bot rollback release/2026-03-22 --to v1.3.x`.
sre-oncall: Confirmed. If we hit rollback thresholds, I'll fire the incident and tag @sre-oncall. Please also post to #incidents.
jordan: I'll watch the dashboards (errors, latency, model-quality evals). If anything flares I'll call rollback.
leo: PR for deploybot pins pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/changes/823. Link in the runbook doc too.
amira: Internal release doc published: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/2026-03-22 — includes blurb, runbook, rollback cmds, and pin matrix.
product-comm: Preview of internal blurb: "Today we're rolling out routing and infra improvements to inference. Pinned to v1.4.2. No action required. Canary 14:15 PST; internal stand-by 14:00–16:00." Approve?
maria: Approved. Standby rota: leo, amira, sre-oncall 14:00–16:00.
product-comm: I'll send the blast at 15:30.
deploy-bot: Deploy start: 14:01 PST — canary initializing.
jordan: Watching metrics now.
sre-oncall: All good on logs so far. Will escalate if anything.
leo: Can confirm the version pin on prod config applied.
amira: Noted — added the fallback panic-run instructions to the top of the runbook.
product-comm: Sending internal announce now (scheduled). :email:
maria: Thanks team. If we make a rollback decision we follow the runbook and then update the internal thread with root cause notes. Otherwise we'll close this thread at 16:30. :thumbsup:
